'''Snar Extruct''' was a [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a survivor of the destruction of [[Urkupp]] living in the years proceeding the passage of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Extruct befriended the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Skarch Vaunk]], traveling to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to serve as sparring partner to the great [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="TJP" />
